description: This file implements a Kubernetes resource quota monitoring component, including the QuotaMonitor struct, event handling, informer setup, and resource change processing logic.

classes.name: QuotaMonitor
classes.description: Main struct for monitoring resource quotas, managing informers, event queues, and resource change processing.

classes.name: monitor
classes.description: Internal struct representing a controller and its stop channel.

classes.name: event
classes.description: Represents a resource event (add, update, delete) with associated object and resource info.

methods.name: NewMonitor
methods.description: Creates a new QuotaMonitor instance with provided configuration.

methods.name: controllerFor
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a controller for a specific resource, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: SyncMonitors
methods.description: Reconciles the set of active monitors with the desired resources.

methods.name: StartMonitors
methods.description: Starts all configured monitors and their informers.

methods.name: IsSynced
methods.description: Checks if all monitors are synced and ready.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the quota monitor, processing events until context cancellation.

methods.name: runProcessResourceChanges
methods.description: Processes resource change events from the queue.

methods.name: processResourceChanges
methods.description: Dequeues and handles individual resource events.
